# The Empire
The Empire is an **imperial monarchic government** ruled **jointly** by the Emperor and the Empress, whose sovereign authority stands at the pinnacle of the realm. Their power is supported and guided by _the Council_, also known as the _Senate_ — a body of trusted high-ranking members who advise the throne, deliberate on matters of war and law, and vote on major decisions to preserve balance, wisdom, and stability within the Empire. The Empire itself stands as the supreme capital above all cities and territories, serving as the political, cultural, and architectural heart of the realm. A State, formed when ten individuals unite under a chosen leader, is recognized as a Duchy. Each Duchy operates as a **semi-independent domai**n, maintaining its own army, culture, and internal governance while **remaining loyal to imperial authority**. As long as a Duchy remains linked to the Empire, it is bound to follow imperial commands, shared values, laws, and architectural standards. Through official war games, **a Duchy may challenge another; the victorious Duchy earns full independence** and ascends to the rank of Barony. _Once elevated to Barony status, it is no longer subject to imperial rule and may form its own alliances, conduct trade freely, and determine its own destiny beyond the Empire._[Our Website!](https://theempire.vercel.app/)       [Our Discord Server!](https://discord.gg/gy5xjnMVEJ)
